assertion: An event exists, described as "Euclid discovers oldest quasars".
judge_quote: The Euclid space telescope has spotted the oldest quasars — the brightest objects in the universe — ever discovered
evidence_cited: The Euclid space telescope has spotted the oldest quasars — the brightest objects in the universe — ever discovered, deepening a cosmic mystery that has been puzzling scientists.

In a study published on Monday, an international team of astronomers announced they had discovered 31 quasars, including the two oldest observed yet, using the European Space Agency's Euclid telescope, which is at a stable hovering spot around 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Euclid transformed quasar hunting".
judge_quote: the launch of Euclid in 2023 "has transformed this field," Daming Yang, the lead author of the study in Astronomy & Astrophysics, told AFP.
evidence_cited: Previous quasar hunts were mostly carried out with ground-based telescopes, but the launch of Euclid in 2023 "has transformed this field," Daming Yang, the lead author of the study in Astronomy & Astrophysics, told AFP.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Euclid doubled known ancient quasars".
judge_quote: In just two years, Euclid has doubled the number of ancient quasars known to science
evidence_cited: In just two years, Euclid has doubled the number of ancient quasars known to science, added Yang, a PhD student at Leiden University in the Netherlands.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Euclid is a game-changer for quasar hunting".
judge_quote: "Euclid is a true game-changer," Yang said in a statement.
evidence_cited: "Euclid is a true game-changer," Yang said in a statement.

"Before, we could only find a handful of the very brightest ancient quasars, but Euclid lets us search far more efficiently across huge areas of sky to capture much fainter light. It's a unique tool for quasar hunting."

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Quasars used as lighthouses to study reionization".
judge_quote: "We can use quasars as a lighthouse to study the gas between us and them, so that we can trace how the universe was reionized through this cosmic history," Daming Yang said.
evidence_cited: "We can use quasars as a lighthouse to study the gas between us and them, so that we can trace how the universe was reionized through this cosmic history," Daming Yang said.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Cosmic objects bigger than expected".
